metadata.description: Combined recommended Watcher task: packages the ingest-watch-daily index template and the daily watch (day-over-day primary-store ingest from .monitoring-es-* index_stats into ingest-watch-daily for Lens). Apply template then watch via Dev Tools; can coexist with legacy ingest-watch-daily-internal.

Daily primary-store ingest from .monitoring-es-* index_stats. Writes yesterday per index plus a cluster rollup into ingest-watch-daily for Lens. Part of the combined recommended Watcher task (template + watch).

script.source: return ctx.payload.aggregations != null && ctx.payload.aggregations.indices != null && ctx.payload.aggregations.indices.buckets != null && ctx.payload.aggregations.indices.buckets.size() > 0;

String family(String n) { if (n == null) return 'other'; String s = n.toLowerCase(); if (s.contains('.monitoring') || s.contains('stack_monitoring') || s.contains('.kibana') || s.contains('.security') || s.contains('.watcher') || s.contains('.tasks') || s.contains('.async-search') || s.contains('.fleet') || s.contains('elastic_agent')) return 'system'; if (s.contains('apm') || s.contains('traces-') || s.contains('span') || s.contains('transaction')) return 'apm'; if (s.contains('kafka') || s.contains('connect')) return 'kafka'; if (s.contains('metric') || s.contains('prometheus') || s.contains('prom-') || s.contains('vsphere')) return 'metrics'; if (s.contains('logs-') || s.contains('filebeat') || s.contains('winlog') || s.contains('syslog') || s.contains('fluent') || s.contains('vector') || s.contains('iis') || s.contains('openshift') || s.contains('audit')) return 'logs'; return 'other'; } def buckets = ctx.payload.aggregations.indices.buckets; def targetDay = null; def latest = null; for (idx in buckets) { for (d in idx.by_day.buckets) { def day = d.key_as_string.substring(0, 10); if (latest == null || day.compareTo(latest) > 0) latest = day; } } targetDay = latest; def docs = []; def clusterIngest = 0L; def clusterMax = 0L; def clusterDocs = 0L; for (idx in buckets) { def points = []; for (d in idx.by_day.buckets) { def rec = ['day': d.key_as_string.substring(0, 10), 'size': (d.max_size.value == null ? 0L : (long)d.max_size.value), 'docs': (d.max_docs.value == null ? 0L : (long)d.max_docs.value)]; points.add(rec); } points.sort((a, b) -> a.day.compareTo(b.day)); def prev = null; for (p in points) { def delta; if (prev == null) { delta = p.size; } else { def raw = p.size - prev.size; delta = raw > 0L ? raw : 0L; } if (p.day.equals(targetDay)) { def name = idx.key; docs.add(['_id': targetDay + '|' + name, '@timestamp': targetDay + 'T00:00:00Z', 'day': targetDay, 'index_name': name, 'stream_family': family(name), 'scope': 'index', 'max_primary_bytes': p.size, 'max_docs': p.docs, 'ingest_bytes': delta, 'prev_primary_bytes': (prev == null ? 0L : prev.size), 'source': 'watcher', 'collection': 'internal']); clusterIngest += delta; clusterMax += p.size; clusterDocs += p.docs; } prev = p; } } docs.add(['_id': targetDay + '|_cluster', '@timestamp': targetDay + 'T00:00:00Z', 'day': targetDay, 'index_name': '_cluster', 'stream_family': 'cluster', 'scope': 'cluster', 'max_primary_bytes': clusterMax, 'max_docs': clusterDocs, 'ingest_bytes': clusterIngest, 'prev_primary_bytes': 0L, 'source': 'watcher', 'collection': 'internal']); return ['docs': docs, 'target_day': targetDay, 'doc_count': docs.size()];
